description: Place a wholesale order for the seller, delivered to their FLUF billing address unless another is given. Returns a pay_url per supplier: the seller opens it and pays by card; nothing is charged by this call. Payment is held until the seller confirms the goods arrived as described. Unpaid orders expire after 24 hours and hold no stock. Confirm the quote_wholesale_order total with the seller first.

address.description: Full delivery address with postcode, if not the billing address

country.description: Delivery country, ISO 3166 alpha-2 (e.g. GB). Defaults to the seller's billing country.

qty.description: In the lot's unit (piece, kg, bale); at least its moq

name.description: Business or recipient name, if not the account name

name: place_wholesale_order
